newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index off slightly, turnover up.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index off slightly, turnover up.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Thursday closed down by 0.19 percent in increased trade, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 581.74 from 582.84 on Wednesday.
Trade volume was 2.34 million against 2.15 million dinars.
Capital goods trading firm Le Moteur was down 6.64 dinars to 28.36 dinars. Retail stores Monoprix eased 1.04 dinar to 33.86 dinars. Investment fund SPDIT-SICAF was down 1.1 dinar to 35.71 dinars.
BTEI bank was up 0.64 dinar to 22.48 dinars, while Tunis Air was up 0.4 dinar to 16 dinars. ($=one dinar)
